root_cause.text: In `z_erofs_pcluster_begin()`, inline data for ztailpacking pclusters was read **after** the pcluster was allocated and added to I/O chains, so if the read failed (e.g., due to a fatal signal), the pcluster would be queued with an invalid `compressed_bvecs[0].page`, leading to a NULL pointer dereference in `z_erofs_decompress_pcluster()`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Compressed folios for ztailpacking pclusters must be valid before adding these pclusters to I/O chains. Otherwise, z_erofs_decompress_pcluster() may assume they are already valid and then trigger a NULL pointer dereference." The patch moves the `erofs_bread()` call (which reads the inline data) from the else branch (after pcluster allocation) to the if branch (before pcluster allocation and I/O chain addition).

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing handling of metadata clusters in z_erofs_pcluster_begin by adding branch for EROFS_MAP_META to read inline data properly.
intent_record.what: Changed initialization of ptr to NULL, inverted the condition from if (!(map->m_flags & EROFS_MAP_META)) to if (map->m_flags & EROFS_MAP_META), and added a new block handling metadata clusters by reading inline data via erofs_init_metabuf and erofs_bread, with error checking and setting ptr to the buffer page; the original logic moved into an else branch.
intent_record.how: At runtime, when the map flag includes EROFS_MAP_META, the function now initializes a metabuf, reads the inline data page, and handles errors appropriately, whereas previously this case was not explicitly handled. For non-meta clusters, the original loop to find or create a pcluster is retained.

intent_record.intent_summary: Simplify the inline decompression path by reusing an already available page pointer instead of performing a separate metadata read.
intent_record.what: In the else branch of z_erofs_pcluster_begin, removed calls to erofs_init_metabuf and erofs_bread, and replaced folio_get and WRITE_ONCE to use a pre-existing pointer `ptr` instead of map->buf.page.
intent_record.how: The function no longer initializes a metadata buffer or reads data from disk in this path; it assumes `ptr` already points to the correct page, thus streamlining the code and avoiding redundant I/O.

Simplify the inline decompression path by reusing an already available page pointer instead of performing a separate metadata read.
